title: FAQ: Troubleshooting
summary: This document provides troubleshooting guidance for mobile app/web issues: update to the latest app or a supported browser, confirm an active account and correct sign-in profile, verify stable connectivity, and run the `refresh_cache()` tool to clear cached site data. It includes scenario steps for balance not updating, missing/pending transactions, stuck transfers, and sign-in problems, plus escalation conditions.
faqs: What quick checks should I try if the mobile app or website isn’t working?
How do I clear cached site data—should I use `refresh_cache()` and what should I be told to run?
My balance isn’t updating after a deposit—what steps should I follow?
A transaction is missing or still pending—what does the document recommend checking?
Why might transfers appear stuck, and what should I verify?
When should I escalate the issue after running `refresh_cache()`?
